issues: After the hero the voyage collapses into ~3000px of empty black: chapters rely 100% on the sticky stage, so wherever it isn't visible (full-page capture, slow image load, odd viewports) the chapters are dead space
Chapter panels started at opacity 0 and only appeared via IntersectionObserver, so chapters 04–07 rendered completely invisible; looked broken
Each chapter was 100vh with a small 560px card, so the rhythm was huge voids and tiny cards and the catalog, ports and finale were pushed far below the fold
Chapter panels had no imagery, only text cards that look like generic template boxes
Mobile hero: body copy and the small headline sit on bright sail/sky with a weak scrim, so contrast is low; headline lacks scale on 390px
Brand-colour robustness is decent (lift/tint derive from primary) but the stress brand shows the same emptiness
fixed: Added a 'viewfinder' frame to every chapter panel: JS clones the exact image the stage cross-fades to into the top of the panel, with a chapter counter caption and a slow zoom-settle on enter, so the chapter carries its own image even when the stage isn't visible

Huge outlined italic ghost numerals (01–07) set opposite each panel in the brand-derived lift colour, drifting into place on enter; fills the void with editorial typography and strengthens the chapter/rail metaphor
Panels are no longer opacity-gated: the reveal is transform-only, so content is never invisible

Tightened the chapter rhythm: non-hero chapters go from 100vh to 74vh (auto height on mobile) so the voyage is denser and the product section and finale arrive sooner; cross-fade still triggers at the viewport midline
Mobile hero: stronger bottom scrim, text-shadow and a bigger clamp on the headline for legibility and impact
